apps/web/src/features/people/corrections.reason: Consumes the one-time Not a duplicate confirmation once the list has displayed it, so it shows once and never again after leaving and returning, after Back or after a reload. It must be consumed when it is displayed, never by a later event: the location store reports only Back, Forward and its own writes, not a link or router navigation away from the list, so an event-driven clear would miss leaving by link and show the confirmation again; clearing it in render is impure and a retried render would lose it
